title: Pullback compatibility of the explicit unit comparison map
statement: Let k be a field and a:Y→X a morphism over k, with structure morphisms f and g and a≫f=g. The explicitly constructed additive maps scalarUnitAbelianComparison X and scalarUnitAbelianComparison Y [new-sc-scalar-unit-comparison-family] intertwine scalarCohomologyPullback followed by scalarCohomologyMap of tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations, lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf] with structureSheafCohomologyPullback [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback]. No arbitrary comparison family is quantified, and no bijectivity assertion is included.

proof.text: Factor both explicit unit comparisons through forgotten scalar Ext. Use scalarCohomologyExtEquiv_map for coefficient naturality, and cancel the Ext equivalence against its inverse in scalarCohomologyPullback.

Obtain the exact-functor square with its integer-unit and coefficient identities. Apply mapExactFunctor_square with scalar Ext universes u+1 and abelian Ext universes u. Yoneda associativity combines the coefficient and unit equations into the defining formula for structure-sheaf pullback.

proof_origin.place: Factorization through scalar Ext followed by exact-functor square naturality and integer-unit/coefficient compatibility

theorem scalar_unit_cohomology_pullback_naturality (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (a : Y ⟶ X) (h : a ≫ f = g)
    (x : scalarCohomology f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1) :
    scalarUnitAbelianComparison Y
      (scalarCohomologyMap g (tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit a) 1
        (scalarCohomologyPullback f g a h (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1 x)) =
      structureSheafCohomologyPullback a 1 (scalarUnitAbelianComparison X x)
